title: The Quiet Habit That Builds Wealth
intro: Most people think wealth starts with a big salary. It does not. It starts with one quiet habit that almost nobody keeps.

chapters.title: The leak you never see
chapters.text: Every month, money slips away in small amounts. A subscription here. A delivery fee there. None of it feels like much. [sigh] But add it up over a year and it is often more than a full paycheck. The problem is not that you spend. The problem is that you never decide where the money goes before it leaves.

chapters.title: Pay yourself first
chapters.text: The fix is simple. On payday, move a fixed amount into savings before you pay a single bill. Treat it like rent you owe your future self. Start small if you must. Five percent is fine. What matters is that it happens every single month, automatically, without a debate. [chuckle] Your willpower is not needed when the transfer is already set.

chapters.title: Why it compounds
chapters.text: Here is the part most people miss. Saved money does not just sit there. Invested in a simple index fund, it grows, and then the growth grows too. Ten years of a small habit can quietly beat a decade of big raises. It is not exciting. It is not fast. But it works, and it keeps working while you sleep.

outro: Set up the transfer today, before you forget. Subscribe for one more money rule every week.
